question: Does TD3's 10× higher actor learning rate explain why TRM 788k failed to train in Stage T?

gate: GT2: 'LR explains the TD3 failure' if TRM 788k learns (final avg-100 > −1000) in ≥ 10/12 runs at some actor LR < 1e-3; then TRM − MLP at that LR (n = 12, sign test).
baseline: Stage T (actor LR 1e-3): TRM 788k learned 2/12; MLP 788k 12/12.
